steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ with bids from Vendor A at 100 and Vendor B at 90.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Open the RFQ Settings menu and choose Recreate Order.
Verify that the Recreate Order popup opened.
Verify the popup includes the Product Sheet option.
Verify the popup includes Auction Configurations.
Verify the popup includes Delivery Date.
Verify the popup includes the scheduling choice.
Click the popup's top-right close control.
Verify that closing the popup dismisses it without continuing the recreate flow.
